Resolves #21892

Drag & Drop now lists every example a visitor drags: 11 entries where there were 3. Each is cross-listed from its home group with `alsoIn`:
- the Sprint Board and its columns;
- a dialog dragged across windows;
- browser-style tabs;
- the dialog example;
- reordered lists;
- the scheduler's drag and resize;
- two Gantt plans;
- docked panes;
- the TV rundown.

The Dock Pane Pop-out leaves the group: it moves its pane with a pop-out action, not a drag. State & Data borrows the simulated server and the streamed load. The group's line and its SEO title name what the entries drag.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium frames of both pages; the catalog's unit and NL e2e specs locally) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3 to AC-5). No residual.

CI jobs: +0.

## Deltas from ticket
- `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` no longer pins "Drag & Drop, 3 matching examples". Under the query "drag", every member matches through its group's title, so the spec derives the count from the group files with the publish rule, in the app's own `catalogMode`. A record cross-listed in parallel turns nothing red, which was Grace's recommendation; her `file-explorer` (#21952) and `dashboard-sortable` (#21921) join in their own PRs.
- `seo.json` carries what the generator now produces for `/examples/drag-drop` (the title `Seo.mjs` serves, 11 examples) and `/examples/state` (3 examples). `Seo.spec`'s title parity caught the first.
- The findQuery unit test no longer expects the pop-out to answer "drag".

## Test Evidence
Locally at this head:
- The catalog and SEO unit specs pass, 137 tests.
- `portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` passes, 31 tests.
